answer:
The OpenAI-compatible endpoint that lets apps stream speech audio generated by Ollama on macOS is `/v1/audio/speech`. This is supported by the Ollama version 0.40.11, as mentioned in the context provided.

Specifically, the line stating this is:

"Generates audio with [speech models](/capabilities/speech). The response streams while audio is generated."

This line can be found in [ollama/docs/api/openai-compatibility.md](https://github.com/ollama/ollama/releases/tag/v0.40.11) (lines 318-335).
